notes: The nine still-unreviewed 2026 Calendar selections now have object leads; primary catalogue confidence varies and is stated per row
Museum object information must not be elevated to selected source photograph or licence
Do not treat a Commons photo of a Prado painting as a permitted exception to the no-Prado image policy
For Sacchi compare the Prado painting with separate Lateran-cycle canvases and later prints, not just title
No automatic transfer of prior gallery choices, including the San Rocco Circumcision shared Prayer scene

records.title: The Circumcision
records.institution: Scuola Grande di San Rocco, Venice
records.finding: Previously identified 1587 San Rocco original is a plausible shared work with batch9 Prayer identity; substantial workshop and Domenico involvement explicitly noted. Date-specific chosen photograph not matched to Prayer's photo; keep as two separate placement edges.

records.artist: Peter Paul Rubens and Anthony van Dyck
records.title: The Anointing at Bethany
records.institution: State Hermitage Museum, St Petersburg (secondary reports only)
records.finding: Independent secondary discussions call it a 1618 Rubens–van Dyck collaboration at Hermitage, depicting John 12:1–11; primary museum accession and exact physical canvas not directly verified.

records.title: Appearance of Christ to His Disciples
records.institution: State Hermitage Museum (Commons-reported, primary catalogue not fetched)
records.finding: Commons source describes van Dyck 1625–26 oil canvas and Hermitage custody. Original museum accession and selected photo remain unverified; do not infer from shared title.

records.title: The Sending Out of the Twelve Disciples
records.finding: Museum confirms anonymous North Netherlandish oil canvas ca.1573, object 2474; exact 1962 Gospel subject appropriate; Commons image available but not specifically owner-selected or photo-cleared.

records.title: Jesus Restoring to Health Peter's Wife's Mother
records.finding: Birmingham's official painting record gives John Bridges, 1833, signed 'John Bridges / Roma 1833', collection 1978.29. Commons metadata describes same sized object but calls it 1839; official object date supersedes that field, without asserting Commons photograph is approved.

records.title: The Birth of Saint John the Baptist
records.institution: Museo del Prado, Madrid (inventory represented by Commons painting index; object page inaccessible during review)
records.finding: Commons original is an uploaded Prado photograph of Sacchi's Birth of St John, painting index lists P000003. Prado object page could not be directly read. A separate painting subject by Sacchi for Lateran cycle and later prints/copies must not be conflated.

records.title: The Family of Christ
records.institution: National Museum in Wrocław digital collections
records.object_id: MNWr VIII-2328 (secondary Commons accession; institutional page confirms work)
records.finding: Museum digital collection identifies 1677–79 oil on oak panel (119x73cm), family/genealogy of Jesus; separate Commons metadata associates inventory MNWr VIII-2328. Selected source photo not QA-cleared.

records.title: Saint John the Baptist Interrogated about Christ
records.finding: National Trust identifies St John interrogated in John 1:19–28, historically mislabelled 'Incredulity of Saint Thomas'; do not merge with the separate Strozzi Woman of Samaria apparent pendant (NT108872). Historic attribution debates must remain source-scoped.

records.title: La Prédication de saint Jean Baptiste
records.finding: Louvre confirms Gaulli Baciccio oil on canvas, INV20298; older Dijon deposit ended 1968. Do not confuse separate Natoire copy or Giovanni Battista Tiepolo preaching pictures.
